variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: A diffusion model is a generative model that learns to reverse a gradual noising process. At inference time, it starts with random noise and repeatedly predicts how to move that sample toward data that resembles its training distribution. Text-to-image systems add text conditioning so those updates also follow a prompt.
variants.prompt: Match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Validate and admit
pairs.detail: Authenticate the tenant, normalize dimensions and parameters, classify policy, estimate work, reserve quota, and assign an idempotent job ID.
pairs.explanation: Authenticate the tenant, normalize dimensions and parameters, classify policy, estimate work, reserve quota, and assign an idempotent job ID.

pairs.label: Queue compatible work
pairs.detail: Separate latency classes and batch only requests with compatible model, shape, conditioning, precision, and safety contracts.
pairs.explanation: Separate latency classes and batch only requests with compatible model, shape, conditioning, precision, and safety contracts.

pairs.label: Generate with a lease
pairs.detail: Load the pinned model bundle, claim a bounded lease, propagate cancellation, emit progress, and checkpoint only when recovery value exceeds storage cost.
pairs.explanation: Load the pinned model bundle, claim a bounded lease, propagate cancellation, emit progress, and checkpoint only when recovery value exceeds storage cost.

pairs.label: Evaluate before publish
pairs.detail: Run output safety, quality, provenance, and product-specific checks outside the model.
pairs.explanation: Run output safety, quality, provenance, and product-specific checks outside the model. Fail closed when a mandatory decision is unavailable.

pairs.label: Commit one result
pairs.detail: Atomically record the terminal state and object reference, notify once, and retain the execution manifest needed for replay and incident review.
pairs.explanation: Atomically record the terminal state and object reference, notify once, and retain the execution manifest needed for replay and incident review.

variants.hint:
Validate and admit: Authenticate the tenant, normalize dimensions and parameters, classify policy, estimate work, reserve quota, and assign an idempotent job ID.

Queue compatible work: Separate latency classes and batch only requests with compatible model, shape, conditioning, precision, and safety contracts.

Generate with a lease: Load the pinned model bundle, claim a bounded lease, propagate cancellation, emit progress, and checkpoint only when recovery value exceeds storage cost.

Evaluate before publish: Run output safety, quality, provenance, and product-specific checks outside the model.

Commit one result: Atomically record the terminal state and object reference, notify once, and retain the execution manifest needed for replay and incident review.
variants.explanation: Each part has a distinct responsibility. Keeping these boundaries clear helps you find the place to change when the system behaves unexpectedly.
